tei:div.tei:p: / e ma ho/ /rab dkar las dang smon lam bzang pos 'phangs/ /kun mkhyen rje yis ma nor lam bstan pa'i/ /zab lam snying po 'di la bsgrod tshul ni/ /bla med bla ma mchog la rab gus te/ /bdag gzhan thar lam chen por 'dun pa 'phangs/ /spyi mthun grub pa'i lam du mngon sum nas/ /snang zhing srid par 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i chos/ /ma spangs gnas su dag pa ru shan phyed/ /stong nyid phu thag chod pa rtsa bral gshis/ /ji bzhin mngon du gyur par rnal du dbab/ rig pa gcer bu lhings la rten med du/ /gzo med zhen bral gsal stong rang sor bzhag /gang shar gzo med rang grol khregs chod kyi/ / don khrid mnyam nyid ro gcig de ltar bskyangs/ /rang rig gsal stong mngon sum rjen pa la/ /yengs med blo bral thog rgal don khrid bskyangs/ /skye med stong pa gshis kyi phu thag chod/ /rang rig gsal stong mngon sum thil du phebs/ /gang shar spros bral rjen pa'i rang zhal bltas/ /'bral med chos nyid rol par dran pas mchog /gzung 'dzin rtsis gdab zhen yul mtha' dang bral/ /bar snang nang du nam mkha' bsgom pa la/ /yang dag dran pas rang sor so mar bzhag /a+thi+-i/ ༄༅/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs pa yis/ /rin chen sems nyid mngon du bstan/ /yang dag ye shes bde ba'i mchog /lhun grub ngang du gus pas 'dud/ /mkha' dbyings phyogs med mtha' bral du/ /'gro ba rang rtsal 'gag med pa/ /snying po rnams la mngon gyur ni/ /thig le spros med ngang du rtogs/ /de'i lung bla ma dam pa las/ /bdag cag sprang po ri pa yis/ / dben gnas brag nag pho brang du/ /lcags byi zla ba gsum pa ste/ /gter nas byon lo zhe brgyad la/ /dbang khrid lung dpe man ngag rdzogs/ /btags sgom dran pas grol ba'i chos/ /yongs rdzogs zhus nas rang gzhan don/ / gnyis ka gyis kyi rjes gnang thob/ /gzhan yang gnas mchog tsā ri yi/ / yon bdag rgyal po smon lam gyis/ /sngar 'das lo ni bco lnga'i gong*/

/ gter ston zhal slob sho ban gyi/ /phyag dpe dad pa'i shugs kyis phul/ /o rgyan rje dang gdams pa la/ /sngon gyi las 'brel bzang po yi/ /nus pa yod nges snyam pa yis/ /dga' dang spro ba tshad med skyes/ /deng sang bdag por nges pa na/ /dad brtson 'dun pa cher bskyed de/ /ka dag lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /rang bzhin stong gsal 'gag pa med/ /kun khyab dbye ba med pa'i don/ /rtsol bral theg mchog rdzogs chen dang*/ khregs chod thod rgal zung 'jug dang*/ /btags grol thabs cha la sogs pas/ /'di phyi 'chi kha bar do ru/ /rang blo nus pa'i rim stobs kyis/ /'phyugs med sku gsum rang chas su/ /thob pa lung rig myong ba gsal/ /e ma de yang rje yi drin/ /drin lan bsab pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /phul ba'i 'bras bu 'gro rnams sems/ / sems nyid rnal ma blo bral don/ /don dam ji bzhin rtogs pa la/ /la bzla ba 'di 'da' ba med/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs ji bzhin snang ba la/ /'gag med rang grol rtogs pa rje yi drin/ /ston 'khor gcig tu 'dres pa'i yul las 'das/ ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa gnyug ma'i ngang*/ rtsol bral bya byed med pa so ma'i don/ cis kyang chog pa 'dug pas blo re bde'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa shes rab tshul khrims de nyid la dben gnas brag nag tu dam pa chos nyid shes rab kyis dbang dang chos skor thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thugs nyams su bzhes shing khyad par khrid kyi dom khregs chod kyis yin lugs mngon du gyur par mdzad nas/ thod rgal gyis 'phyugs med gnad kyis mngon sum rang thog tu gtan la phab nas dus de nyid du kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa mngon du mdzad pa'o/ /dam pa pra dzñā shrī de nyid las dben gnas brag nag gi pho brang du bdag nam mkha' grags kyis dbang dang lung rnams yongs su rdzogs par zhus kyang*/ khrid kyi nges pa ma rnyed pa la/ dus phyis sprul sku rig 'dzin rgod gyi ldem 'phru can dang mjal dus chos kyi che ba dang*/

khrid kyi zab pa'i gnad lung bstan pa'i bka' drin la brten nas/ dpal ldan bla ma chos nyid mtshan can de nyid dben gnas brag nag pho brang du spyan drangs shing shing mo bya lo'i ston zla 'bring po dang ra ba gnyis la dbang lnga yongs su rdzogs pa lung rnams dang bcas pa bskyangs nas zhus te/ khyad par khrid kyi skor khregs chod thod rgal rnams nyams khrid lag khrid du rdzogs par zhus shing*/ nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba cung zad skyed pa dang*/ snang bzhi'i 'char tshul rnams go yul du gsal zhing*/ zab mo'i chos la nges pa'i shes pa dang*/ brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob dus/ dbang rdzogs/ bka' rdzogs dpe rdzogs lung rnams yongs su rdzogs par gnang ste rang gzhan gyi don gnyis ka gyis shig pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob ste sa dang po'i dga' ba lta bur gyur to// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)g.yung gi lo rgyus/ - PAGE 160 - - PAGE 159 -- PAGE 157 -
